title: Awesome & Tanaka bring their rivalry to ECW’s world title
summary: Mike Awesome and Masato Tanaka bring a punishing rivalry from Japan to ECW. Their repeated collisions eventually become a rapid exchange of the world championship.

chapters.title: Tanaka wins the Heat Wave encounter
chapters.context: Their ECW pay-per-view encounter establishes the rivalry for the American audience.

chapters.title: Awesome wins the world championship
chapters.result: Awesome defeats Taz and Tanaka in the three-way title match.
chapters.context: After the champion is eliminated, the familiar rivals determine who leaves with the belt.

chapters.title: Tanaka takes Awesome’s title
chapters.result: Tanaka defeats Awesome for the championship.
chapters.context: The recording date precedes the December 24 broadcast.

chapters.title: Awesome wins the rematch
chapters.result: Awesome defeats Tanaka to regain the world title.
chapters.context: Recorded six days after Tanaka’s win, the reversal aired on December 31.
